summary: Hogback Mountain, Rockbridge County, VA: lookout listed as removed under the George Washington National Forest; no build or staffing record in the sources read.

facts.status_note: Listed as removed and gone; the sources read give no removal date and no description of the site today.

notes_for_editor: Only a removal note and a registry entry describe this Rockbridge tower; no build date, staffing, photos or site description were found in two searches. Do not mix it with us-va-hogback-mountain (Warren/Rappahannock, Shenandoah NP, CPS tower removed 1962). The WillhiteWeb page is cited to warn readers about that other mountain and for its 1942-43 build and 1962 removal. Goshen WMA is cited for location context only; no source ties this lookout to that ridge.
